description: A minimal Nuxt 3 static/prerendered app, obfuscated via @afterpack/nuxt (a real defineNuxtModule that registers @afterpack/vite on Nuxt's Vite config). @afterpack runs on Vite's closeBundle, so the client bundle is obfuscated before nitro prerenders into .output/public. Proves a prerendered Nuxt page hydrates + the reactive counter interaction works in chromium with the obfuscated client.

build.note: nuxt generate obfuscates the client bundle on closeBundle (via @afterpack/nuxt -> @afterpack/vite); buildId pinned in nuxt.config.ts for determinism

interactions.description: The obfuscated client hydrates the prerendered page; the reactive counter increments on click.
